title: 住まいと近所づきあい

question.en: What makes a town a great place to live?
question.ja: 住みやすい街の条件は？

hintEn: Parks are more important than shops.
We can shop online, but we can't walk in a park online.
Green places make people calm and healthy.

goals.ja: schoolsを下から2位以内にする
hintEn: Schools should be near the bottom.
Not everyone has children.
Many kids take a train to school anyway.
Trains must be number one.
Without trains, you need a car for everything.
A good station makes work and fun easy to reach.
Hospitals have to be first.
When you're sick, nothing else matters.
Older people and families need a hospital nearby.
Shops should be second.
We buy food and daily things almost every day.
They are not the most important, but we use them the most.
Parks belong in the middle, at number three.
Parks are nice, but we don't go every day.
Let's put parks third, above schools.

keyExpressions.en: X is nice, but not necessary.
keyExpressions.ja: Xはあると良いが、なくてもいい

question.en: What matters most when you choose a new home?
question.ja: 部屋探しで一番大事なのは？

hintEn: Sunlight is more important than size.
A dark room makes you feel down.
A small room with lots of sun feels bigger.
The kitchen should be in the top two.
Cooking at home saves a lot of money.
A tiny kitchen makes every meal hard.
Rent must be number one.
You pay rent every single month.
A great home is no good if you can't pay for it.
Location has to be first.
You can change your furniture, but not the station near you.
A long commute takes hours from your life.
Size should be second.
You need space for your things and your friends.
It's very important, but it's not everything.
Sunlight belongs in the middle, at number three.
Sun is nice, but you're at work all day.
Let's put sunlight third, above size.

keyExpressions.en: X is a deal breaker for me.
X matters more than you think.
keyExpressions.ja: Xは思っているより大事だ

question.ja: 良いご近所さんの条件は？

hintEn: Quietness is more important than kindness.
A kind neighbor who is loud at night is still a problem.
I just want to sleep well.
Greetings should be in the top two.
A simple hello makes the whole building friendly.
If we say hello, we can help each other in an emergency.
Privacy must be number one.
A good neighbor doesn't ask about your life.
I don't want anyone watching when I come home.
Greetings should be last.
You don't have to talk to your neighbors to live well.
Many people in big cities never say hello, and that's fine.
Kindness should be second.
Kindness helps when you lose your key or miss a package.
It's very important, but not number one.
Cleanliness belongs in the middle, at number three.
Trash in the hallway is annoying, but it's not the worst.
Let's put cleanliness third, above greetings.

keyExpressions.en: Why do you think X is so important?
keyExpressions.ja: なぜXがそんなに大事だと思うの？

question.en: What matters most in a roommate?
question.ja: ルームメイトに一番求めるものは？

hintEn: Cooking is more important than humor.
Good food at home makes everyone happy.
Jokes don't fill your stomach.
Honesty should be in the top two.
If they lie about small things, you can't trust them.
Living together needs trust.
Tidiness has to be first.
Dirty dishes cause the biggest fights.
A messy room makes the whole home stressful.
Cooking should be last.
You can cook for yourself.
We can always order food.

goals.ja: sleep scheduleをちょうど2位にする
hintEn: The sleep schedule should be second.
Loud noise at 3 a.m. is a real problem.
It matters a lot, but it's not the top.
Humor belongs in the middle, at number three.
Laughing together makes living together easier.
Let's put humor third, right below the sleep schedule.

keyExpressions.en: X causes a lot of fights.
keyExpressions.ja: Xはケンカの原因になりやすい

keyExpressions.en: That's true, but X is still more important.
keyExpressions.ja: それはそうだが、それでもXの方が大事だ

question.en: What is the best pet for a small apartment?
question.ja: 狭い部屋で飼うならどのペット？

hintEn: A cat is better than a dog.
Cats don't need a walk every day.
Dogs need more space to run.

goals.ja: fishを下から2位以内にする
hintEn: Fish should be near the bottom.
You can't play with a fish.
A fish tank is heavy and needs a lot of cleaning.
The dog must be number one.
A small dog can live happily in an apartment.
A dog is the best friend you can have.
The hamster has to be first.
A hamster needs only a small cage.
Hamsters are quiet and cheap to keep.
The rabbit should be second.
Rabbits are quiet, but they need some space.
It's a good pet, but not the best for a tiny room.
The cat belongs in the middle, at number three.
Cats are easy, but they can scratch the walls.
Let's put the cat third, above the dog.

keyExpressions.en: X is easier to take care of than Y.
I agree with you about X.

question.en: What makes a home party fun?
question.ja: ホームパーティを楽しくするのは？

hintEn: Games are more important than music.
Games get everyone talking and laughing.
Music just plays in the background.
Food should be in the top two.
Hungry guests are not happy guests.
Good food is what people remember.
The guests must be number one.
The right people make any party fun.
With good friends, even a bag of chips is a party.
Decorations should be last.
Nobody looks at the walls after ten minutes.
It's a lot of work for very little fun.
Music should be second.
A quiet room feels awkward.
Music sets the mood, but it's not the main thing.
Games belong in the middle, at number three.
Games are fun, but some people don't like them.
Let's put games third, above decorations.

keyExpressions.en: Without X, the party is boring.
keyExpressions.ja: Xがないとパーティは退屈だ
Xはあると嬉しい程度だ
